description: This source file defines a Java class named NamingServiceContainer that implements a container responsible for initializing, starting, and stopping a Java RMI naming service within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages RMI registry creation, host and port configuration, and lifecycle controls for the naming service.

classes.name: NamingServiceContainer
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of an RMI naming service, including initialization, startup, and shutdown within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with configuration, setting up host, port, and socket factory based on external configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates the RMI registry and starts the naming service, marking it as running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Unexports and stops the RMI registry if it is running.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container instance.
